title: Omar Follows the Blue Scarf Smell
youtube_title: Omar Follows the Blue Scarf Smell | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Wonder helps you notice the clues that lead you back to what matters.
summary: Omar is supposed to remember which night-market stall has the blue scarf Papa wants to pick up, loses the place in the crowd of colors, and finds it again by noticing smells, sounds, and a painted kettle.
